# Kaidan of the Enchantress of Ōgi Pieces

> A traditional Japanese kaidan tells of a yōkai named Komayō who lures ōgi players into nocturnal games, before transforming them into yūrei.

## Komayō

- [Kaidan of the Enchantress of Ōgi Pieces](https://en.komayo.page/): A traditional Japanese kaidan tells of a yōkai named Komayō who lures ōgi players into nocturnal games, before transforming them into yūrei.
- [The Dark Chronicles of Komayō](https://en.komayo.page/stories/): Discover the terrifying tales of those who fell victim to Komayō, a malevolent creature who appears at night to seduce lost wanderers.
- [The Princess's Game from the Kansai](https://en.komayo.page/game/): Ōgi is a Japanese variant of shōgi played on an 8x8 board. Its single Gold General, beside the King, promotes to the Free Gold, which moves like a Rook and along the forward diagonals.
- [On the Trail of the Yōkai Komayō](https://en.komayo.page/about/): Among the urban legends of the Kansai, some tales speak of an entity named Komayō who appears on full moon nights to challenge others to ōgi.
- [Still Playing in Osaka's Net Cafés](https://en.komayo.page/urban-legend/): In a net café in Shinsaibashi, Osaka, discover the terrifying story of an IT worker confronted by Komayō, a mysterious creature who challenges him to a final game of ōgi.
